title: Out-of-Class Assignments
text: • Read assigned textbook chapters, articles, online documentation, and instructor-provided materials covering Python programming concepts.
• Review and analyze sample Python programs and code examples.
• Develop algorithms, flowcharts, and pseudocode to solve programming problems.
• Create program design documents, code annotations, and written responses related to programming concepts.
• Document testing results, debugging processes, and program evaluations.
• Design, code, test, and debug Python programs.
• Complete assigned coding exercises, programming projects, and practice activities.
• Analyze, test, debug, and evaluate program correctness and functionality.
• Analyze and validate software solutions from multiple sources, including AI-assisted solutions.
